metrics: Iveco Group is committed to transforming its business and leading the change to a more sustainable future. It constantly pushes towards new solutions and drives innovation in its products and services. Iveco Group has been pioneering the development of environmentally friendly technologies as part of its commitment to safe, efficient, and ecological mobility. With more than 35,000 employees, Iveco Group manufactures in 20 industrial sites around the world using the most advanced technology. Iveco Group is the home of eight unique, yet unified brands. Its product range includes light, medium, and heavy commercial vehicles (IVECO), powertrain (FPT Industrial), buses (HEULIEZ, IVECO BUS), financial services (IVECO CAPITAL), and specialty vehicles (IDV, ASTRA, and MAGIRUS).

"We used to talk about AI having a ´wow´ effect," says Ricciato, "Now we look for the ´know´ effect, as AI´s becoming a natural tool for our colleagues.

Iveco Group determined that artificial intelligence (AI) could tackle a wide-ranging opportunity and challenge for the enterprise. Iveco Group is the first manufacturer/automotive company headquartered in Italy to adopt Azure OpenAI services in a production environment by creating an internal smart chatbot called "Chat IVG," leveraging generative AI. As Chat IVG gains wide acceptance, Iveco Group is identifying, experimenting, and expanding AI use for scenarios where everyday work requires access to a large amount of data, communications, and documentation.

“We go beyond.” That’s key to Iveco Group’s mission—and powers the organization always to be at the cutting edge of technology, to be agile, and to give its customers all possible value as quickly as possible.

Ricciato and his team introduced Chat IVG quickly, making it available initially to just a handful of employees from IT and business functions. These early adopters had the freedom to experiment with AI for a few-days trial period without any pressure to complete specific tasks. An early objective was to teach these new users about AI in a secure, controlled environment. As the trial period ended, this first group was reluctant to give up Chat IVG. And word of mouth soon led other employees to request access. Chat IVG went from five to 25 to hundreds of users. Employees rated Chat IVG 4.7 out of 5 on a Net Promoter Score (NPS) and chose 5 out of 5 when asked whether they wanted to continue using it.
